name: a-repair-may-not-reorder-the-markers
find:
kept_before = [k for k in _marker_keys(prior) if k not in touched.markers]
    kept_after = [k for k in _marker_keys(revised) if k not in touched.markers]
replace:
kept_before = sorted(k for k in _marker_keys(prior) if k not in touched.markers)
    kept_after = sorted(k for k in _marker_keys(revised) if k not in touched.markers)
breaks: the marker comparison sorts, so a reorder is invisible. That is the state the repo was already in when this was written: ai_tells.markers_preserved_validator sorted, so nothing anywhere could see a photograph move to a different point in the post, and the prose written about it then sat beside a different picture (#1129). That validator compares the ordered pairs since #1141; this check stays because it asks which markers the repair was ALLOWED to touch (#1129)
